context: Tests overall convention adherence across the full output_checklist: frozen string literal, file path mirroring, subject(:result), no 'and', let vs let!, queue adapter, aggregate_failures, self-audit, and resource loading.

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: Spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: describe '.call' block
checklist.description: Uses `describe '.call' do` for the class method

checklist.name: subject(:result) defined
checklist.description: Defines `subject(:result)` invoking `.call` on the described class

checklist.name: let vs let! correct
checklist.description: Uses `let` by default; `let!` only where objects must exist before the action

checklist.name: No let_it_be
checklist.description: Does NOT use `let_it_be` anywhere in the spec

checklist.name: queue_adapter :test for job
checklist.description: Sets `queue_adapter = :test` and asserts job enqueuing with `have_enqueued_job` rather than running the job

checklist.name: aggregate_failures used
checklist.description: Uses `aggregate_failures` in at least one example with multiple expectations

checklist.name: No updated_at assertion
checklist.description: Does NOT assert on `updated_at` in any example

checklist.name: Self-audit checklist
checklist.description: answer.md includes a self-audit section that explicitly checks: no 'and' descriptions, let! justification, shared examples referenced, factory persistence choices

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md lists which assets (e.g., output_checklist.md, tdd_proof_checklist.md) were consulted and why

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses literal `Observed RED output` label

checklist.name: Three Observed GREEN blocks
checklist.description: Presents three separate Observed GREEN output blocks at different verification scopes
